LUDO

3D island · 2 to 10 players

Lobby

Paused

How to play

  1. Roll the dice. You need a 6 to bring a piece out of base. A 6 gives an extra turn.
  2. Move one piece the exact number rolled, around the board and into your colored lane.
  3. Land on an opponent’s piece to smash it back to its base.
  4. ★ Star squares (your start and the stop square) are safe. Nobody can be captured there.
  5. You need an exact roll to reach the center.
  6. Single: first player with all pieces home wins.
  7. Team: players alternate Team A / Team B. Teammates never capture each other. The team wins when all its pieces are home.
